feed.description:
# Full-Stack Developer Needed to Build a Complete Website From Figma

I'm looking for an experienced full-stack developer (or team) to build a complete website based on my Figma design. Please read the entire project scope before applying. By accepting this project, you agree to the requirements and expectations listed below.

## 1. Website Pages & Structure

### Landing Page

* A clean, modern homepage designed to introduce the brand, highlight services, and guide users to key sections such as products, free services, and tools.

### Product Pages

* 28+ individual product pages.
* Organized into 8+ categories.
* All product pages will follow the same layout and structure.
* Only the product description and minor icons will differ per page.

### Video Downloader / Viewer / Counter Pages

* 10+ pages total.
* Includes tools such as:

  * Instagram Video Downloader
  * Instagram Profile Picture Viewer
  * Instagram Story Downloader
  * Instagram Followers Counter
  * Similar tools for YouTube, X (Twitter), Facebook, and other supported platforms.
* All pages will use the same layout and functionality.
* Only the text/description changes per page.
* Functionality must be fast and reliable.

### Free Service Pages

* 5 to 10 pages.
* Includes services such as:

  * Free Instagram Followers
  * Free Instagram Likes
  * Free Instagram Views
  * Similar services for YouTube, X (Twitter), Facebook, TikTok, and other supported platforms.
* Same layout across all pages.
* Only descriptions differ.

### AI Instagram Growth Page

* Single dedicated page.
* Focused on an AI-based Instagram growth service.
* Clean, modern, conversion-focused design.

### Order Flow Pages

Includes:

* Media selection page (photos/videos).
* Checkout page.
* Thank You page.

Requirements:

* API must fetch user media directly from supported social platforms.
* User should be able to select content easily.
* Smooth transition from media selection to checkout.
* Secure and simple payment process.
* The payment processor is **private for now** and will only be shared with the selected developer. It is **not Stripe or any other popular payment processor**.

### Admin Panel

A complete admin dashboard with the ability to:

* Add and manage third-party API providers.
* Modify pricing.
* Set discounts.
* Create and manage coupon codes.
* View and manage all orders.
* Access general site management tools.
* Manage website content where appropriate.

### Blog

* Standard blog system.
* Ability to post, edit, and manage articles.

### Legal Pages

* Terms of Service.
* Privacy Policy.
* Refund Policy.

### Contact Page

* Simple contact form.
* Email integration.

---

## 2. Hosting Requirements

* The main website will be hosted on Vercel.
* Pages requiring downloading functionality (video downloader tools, etc.) must be hosted separately (such as on DigitalOcean or a similar VPS).
* This setup is required to avoid Vercel limitations and ensure stable performance with predictable monthly costs.

---

## 3. Additional Conditions

* If any page or feature is missing from this document but is clearly required for the website to function properly, you agree to implement it without additional cost.
* Minor adjustments, improvements, and bug fixes are expected as part of the project before final delivery.

---

## 4. Design & Performance Requirements

By accepting this project, you agree to:

* Deliver a 100% pixel-perfect implementation based on the provided Figma design.
* Ensure the website is fully optimized for speed, responsiveness, and overall performance.
* Keep page size as close to **1MB** as reasonably possible.
* Follow modern web development standards and best practices.
* Write clean, maintainable, scalable code.
* Ensure the website works properly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Animations should be clean and fast, i will give animations idea from the reference websites that i have so you can match.

---

## 5. Agreement & Refund Policy

By accepting this project, you agree that:

* If you are unable to complete the project as agreed, or
* If you stop working before the project is completed,

you agree to provide a full refund.

This document serves as the agreement outlining the project scope, expectations, delivery standards, and completion requirements.

## When Applying

Please include:

* Examples of similar websites you've built.
* Your recommended tech stack.
* Estimated timeline.
* Estimated cost.
* Your experience with API integrations, admin dashboards, and large-scale web applications.

All the designs are done already.
